verses.22:29: ثُمَّ لۡيَقۡضُواْ تَفَثَهُمۡ وَلۡيُوفُواْ نُذُورَهُمۡ وَلۡيَطَّوَّفُواْ بِٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡعَتِيقِ

meaning: Tafath (تفث) refers to the acts of personal cleansing performed during pilgrimage, such as shaving, paring nails, and removing body hair.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
